commonality: An unguarded possibly-null value — the URL component field 'urlAddress' (left null by the no-arg URL()/ServiceConfigURL()/URLBuilder() chain), the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo()/getValidServiceInfo()), or a service path read from an invocation attachment (inv.getAttachments().get(PATH_KEY) / inv.getObjectAttachmentWithoutConvert(PATH_KEY)) — is dereferenced or fed into a service-key lookup with no null check, throwing a (misleading) NullPointerException; guard it with a null check, early return/throw, or ternary before use.
message: A possibly-null value (URL component field 'urlAddress', a nullable service-info lookup result from getServiceInfo()/getValidServiceInfo(), or a service path read from an invocation attachment) is used without a null guard. The unguarded dereference/consumption throws a NullPointerException (for the invocation-attachment path this surfaces as a misleading NPE from the service-key cache). Add a null check, early return/throw, or ternary guard before using the value.
